item.title: Rancher shares story with Trump highlighting why Arizona Governor Katie Hobbs should be defeated
Trump-aligned PAC invests $10 million in Texas Senate race supporting Ken Paxton against James Talarico
item.description: MAGA Inc. has spent $10 million on advertisements favoring Ken Paxton in a closely contested Texas Senate race against James Talarico, which could influence the midterm elections.

item.title: FBI captures fugitive from Most Wanted list overseas, accused of $600,000 fraud
MS-13 gang member with machete, wanted for murder, released by Biden-appointed judge, says DHS
item.description: A convicted MS-13 member known as 'La Bruja' is free in California after a federal judge determined ICE lacked a required bond hearing for his detention.
